name: Venezuela (1836–1859)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of yellow, dark blue and red, with the coat of arms in the upper hoist corner of the yellow stripe.
history: Flag of the Republic of Venezuela from 1836, with the national coat of arms moved from the centre to the upper hoist of the yellow stripe. It was used until the Federal War, when the federalists introduced a flag with twenty stars in 1859.
